items.question: How many years of practical experience must a doctor or specialist have to be nominated for UAE citizenship?
items.gold: Not less than 10 years of practical experience.
items.fact: Doctors and specialists need 10 years practical experience for citizenship.

items.question: What condition must a foreign investor meet to be nominated for UAE citizenship?
items.gold: The investor must own a property in the UAE.
items.fact: Foreign investors must own property in the UAE to be nominated.
